image_description: A green golf cart viewed from the rear, carrying a male passenger sitting on the back-facing bench seat. The cart has a beige canopy roof, silver tubular roll bars, and black seating. The background shows a grassy area with other vehicles (RVs, cars) and people, suggesting a recreational or camping setting.

The red taillight housing appears geometrically inconsistent; the plastic lens seems to blend into the green bodywork without a clear seam or gasket line, and the shape is slightly irregular.
Slight warping in the vertical lines of the background vehicles, common in AI generations, but not severe enough to break scene coherence.
